## Summary
Update compatible dependencies: Lucide 1.72.0, Vite 8.3.8, nanoid 3.3.20, minimatch 11.0.8 and the private uv bootstrap 0.13.7. Keep the minimatch change in its own commit. Regenerate the complete 19-artifact uv hash lock with the seven-day release cooldown and keep installer paths and exact-version checks aligned.

Correct Reactor's five standalone uv archive checksums for 0.13.7. Independently downloaded every supported archive and matched its SHA-256 against both the official release sidecar and GitHub asset digest. New fresh-download regression cases failed against the stale checksums; the corrected bootstrap accepts the release archives and still rejects altered downloads before execution.

The paginated GitHub Dependabot inventory reports zero open alerts. The complete supplied PR inventory had no dependency bot PRs, and every bumped package was checked for overlap. Refreshed audits of all four npm sets and OSV queries for 451 Python package/version identities report zero findings. The dedicated TRELLIS.2 CUDA audit also returned zero findings across 133 package, Conda and source-revision queries; OSV's Conda/native coverage remains limited.

The fresh default-branch image scan [43044058183](https://github.com/atomantic/PortOS/actions/runs/43044058183) supplies matching provenance and inventories for both architectures. Its new matches were subsequently triaged by merged PR #15791: upstream image/package blockers remain in #15788 and #15669. This is a reviewed vulnerable-package inventory, not a zero-vulnerability result. The external Eidoverse parent/Deno lock remains unavailable from its owning build. Remaining staged Python compatibility updates are tracked in #15769; unresolved Pixal3D CUDA installation remains in #15710.

## Test plan
- Reactor bootstrap suite: all 15 tests pass, covering all five fresh-download targets and altered-archive refusal. The five fresh-download cases failed before the checksum fix.
- All five standalone uv archives match both upstream checksum sources; all 19 uv PyPI artifact hashes were verified during lock generation.
- Original focused server regressions: 8 files, 210 tests passed. Original full client suite: 1,559 files, 17,691 tests passed.
- Refreshed four npm audits and 451-identity Python OSV/MAL inventory: zero findings.
- Original build and disposable boot smoke passed; the final checksum fix does not alter app boot or frontend code.
- Final pregate passed: server/client structural guards, lint, actionlint and focused tests; the receipt matches committed tree `57196750d2a9383df82409a36f04e8f4b4810666` with `treeStable: true`. All selected hosted suites and required CI Gate passed in [run 43084047086](https://github.com/atomantic/PortOS/actions/runs/43084047086) on exact head `99835b709117ab7d0d8fb1c9c1547390fe580934`. No code review is configured for this task.

Local dependency validation ran **UNCONTAINED** in private worktree dependencies. The required probe exited 2: `contained-run refused (disabled): Docker containment is off`; nothing ran in that probe. npm install lifecycle scripts stayed disabled; only the repository's explicit trusted rebuilds ran. Native Metal/CUDA/model inference was not run. The original uv online resolver could not reach PyPI; the lock was generated with `uv --no-config pip compile` against a complete local index of independently hash-verified release artifacts.

The earlier hosted Ubuntu prerequisite outage is resolved in #15772. A fresh main run independently passed all affected jobs before this run requested one exact-head recovery attempt. Auto-merge was disabled before publishing the Reactor checksum correction then re-enabled pinned to the corrected head after passing local validation. GitHub confirmed MERGED at 2026-11-11T19:17:30Z, merge commit `066dd576789e5df8c45c5cc00a8555a0ce0ce196`. No source workaround, assertion relaxation or protection change was used for the acquisition outage.
